g.text: DeepGEMM SwapAB — DeepSeek-V3.2 decode GEMMs, NVIDIA B300 (sm_103)
M = tokens in the batch. Every config CUPTI-timed and correctness-checked first.
swap-off time ÷ swap-on time — warm L2 (weights in cache)
swap wins while M is small, loses past M≈32 — exactly where the heuristic flips.
cold L2 (decode reality): both variants HBM-bound, 0.94-1.05x — swap costs nothing.
